project.name: FAZÊ
project.audience: Moradores de Parauapebas-PA que precisam resolver tarefas e pessoas locais que querem ganhar dinheiro realizando serviços.
project.theme: Light-first with a complete dark mode toggle
project.emotional_tone: local, confiável, jovem, útil, humano e profissional sem aparência corporativa

design_concepts.name: Praça de Serviços
design_concepts.direction: Off-white surfaces, indigo ink, lime-green action markers, asymmetrical sections and local neighborhood language.
design_concepts.best_for: Recommended MVP direction; makes local commerce feel human and memorable.

design_concepts.name: Sinal Verde
design_concepts.direction: Strict hierarchy, bright green status signals and indigo navigation anchors.
design_concepts.best_for: High scanability in proposals, status and chat.

design_concepts.name: Caderno de Bairro
design_concepts.direction: Warm paper texture, ink-like dividers and small handwritten accent labels used sparingly.

design_concepts.name: Radar Local
design_concepts.direction: Compact discovery screens with signal dots, distance labels and dark-mode depth.

design_concepts.name: Ritmo FAZÊ
design_concepts.direction: Large typographic moments, offset chips and energetic transitions without gradients.
design_concepts.best_for: Onboarding and empty states, not dense task flows.

research.application: Borrow the research patterns for usability, but express them through local Brazilian visual language rather than generic marketplace UI.

typography.rationale: Manrope gives a friendly, contemporary headline voice; IBM Plex Sans keeps forms and chat highly legible; mono is reserved for status IDs, timestamps and labels.

rules.body: text-base leading-relaxed; use text-sm only for metadata

typography.implementation: Use CSS @import or local font loading in .js project's global stylesheet; create font-family tokens in Tailwind config when available.

colors.archetype: Organic & earthy with indigo civic contrast
rules: Never use pure black or neutral gray
Use indigo only for primary actions and navigation emphasis
Use green for positive status, completed states and confirmation
Ensure normal text contrast is at least 4.5:1

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a barely visible warm paper/noise texture at 3-5% opacity on the app shell; aria-hidden and never behind small text.
visual_enhancers.logo: FAZÊ wordmark in Manrope 800 with a distinctive acute accent; pair with a compact four-stroke task mark, not an emoji.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Prefer 1px tinted borders and restrained ambient shadows; cards should feel flat and tactile, not floating everywhere.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for primary surfaces, rounded-xl for list rows, rounded-full for chips and buttons.
visual_enhancers.scrollbar: Customize to a 6px thumb tinted indigo, with no gutter.
visual_enhancers.break_pattern: Use offset section headers and one intentionally empty grid cell on Home to create breathing room; this breaks generic centered app layouts for local personality.

navigation.desktop_behavior: Keep visible on desktop preview as a bottom navigation rail or centered bottom bar; do not hide links behind hamburger.
navigation.mobile_behavior: Fixed bottom bar with solid surface, backdrop-blur-xl, border-top, z-50 and safe-area padding.
navigation.primary_cta: The + action is larger, indigo filled, and visually interrupts the bar as the creation trigger.

layouts.app_shell: Mobile-first max-width 480px on phone preview, full-width responsive on larger screens; content padding px-5 sm:px-8 and bottom padding for nav.
layouts.home: Asymmetric vertical editorial flow: greeting and mode switch, need input, horizontal category chips, nearby orders list, trust strip. Do not center the whole page.
layouts.explore: Dense but breathable list with search, filter chips and bottom-sheet filters. Use one dominant result column and small status metadata.
layouts.create_order: Four-step progressive flow: necessidade, detalhes, prazo/local, revisar. Show progress indicator and autosave draft affordance.
layouts.order_detail: Top title and trust summary, task description, proposal count, sticky bottom action. Use flat sections, not nested cards.
layouts.proposal: Proposal rows include avatar, name, rating, completed tasks, price, message and accept action; visually prioritize trust before price.
layouts.chat: Conversation-first layout, distinct client/fazedor bubbles, contextual order status header, composer fixed above bottom safe area.
layouts.completion: A calm confirmation scene with status timeline, completion action and evaluation prompt. Avoid confetti overload.
layouts.profile: Trust-led profile: avatar, name, neighborhood, rating, completed jobs, verification, portfolio and settings.

grids.home_tetris: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 with gap-6 md:gap-8; hero need field spans full, nearby orders span 5, trust panel spans 3, leave an intentional breathing cell.
grids.explore_density: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4; list items stretch to equal height; on phone remain a single scan-friendly column.
grids.direct_children_rule: Grid items must be direct children; if using motion.div, give the motion wrapper the grid span classes directly.
grids.container_padding: Every bordered container uses p-6 or p-8; never place text against a border.

components.name: NeedComposer
components.purpose: Primary need input and create-order CTA

components.name: ProposalSheet
components.purpose: Review and accept proposal in context

motion.library: CSS transitions first; use Framer Motion only for route/section transitions if already installed.
motion.entrance: Stagger list rows by 40ms with opacity and translateY(8px); avoid transform on large page containers.
motion.interactions: Buttons transition background-color, color, box-shadow and opacity in 160-220ms; press state scale-[0.98].
motion.proposal_accept: Use a short green confirmation pulse and replace button label with accepted state; do not rely on motion alone.
motion.bottom_sheet: TranslateY with spring-like ease, backdrop scrim at solid rgba color; never complete transparent surface.
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap animations in prefers-reduced-motion media query; reduce to opacity or disable decorative movement.
motion.loading: Use skeleton blocks matching final geometry, not spinner-only loading.

accessibility.focus: Use visible 2px indigo or green focus ring with offset; never remove outline without replacement.
accessibility.labels: Every input has a visible label or aria-label; status colors also include text/icon labels.
accessibility.contrast: Meet WCAG AA minimum; test both themes and hover/focus states.
accessibility.keyboard: Bottom sheets trap focus and close on Escape; chat composer remains keyboard accessible.
accessibility.semantics: Use button for actions, links for navigation, headings in order, aria-live for proposal acceptance and sent-message confirmation.
accessibility.testids: All buttons, links, inputs, menus, error messages, balances/statuses and confirmation text require stable kebab-case data-testid attributes.

media.strategy: No stock photography required for MVP. Use avatars as generated initials or user-provided images; use CSS/icon shapes for categories.
media.rule: Do not add placeholder image URLs. If photography is later added, use image_selector_tool and preserve local context.

3d_libraries.reason: FAZÊ prioritizes Android performance, clarity and task completion over immersion.
3d_libraries.future_option: A lightweight SVG neighborhood signal illustration may be added to an empty state; no map, GPS or WebGL implementation.

data_and_scope.demo_mode: Provide a visible Cliente/Fazedor demo switch with seeded Parauapebas data.
data_and_scope.backend_note: MongoDB is selected for the environment; keep UI states ready for loading, empty, error and optimistic proposal/chat updates.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts, uniform cards or SaaS gradients.
Use generous spacing: prefer p-6/p-8, py-12/py-16 and clear section rhythm.
Use solid or opaque glass surfaces in headers and sheets; never complete transparent backgrounds behind content.
Use Shadcn primitives only for advanced interaction logic when present; customize them to the FAZÊ visual system.
Do not use native select/date-picker for advanced interactions; use accessible menu/calendar primitives if those flows are introduced.
Use Sonner for confirmation/error toasts if the existing project provides it.
Do not use emoji as icons; use lucide-react or existing icon components.
Every interaction needs hover, active, focus and loading feedback with specific property transitions, never transition: all.
Preserve content hierarchy: need first, trust second, action third.
Keep the app feeling like Android mobile UI, not a desktop website squeezed into a phone.
Keep gradients below 20% of the interface and prefer texture, contrast and layering.
Use Portuguese-Brazilian copy with concise, warm language and local place names.

instructions_to_main_agent.starter_template: The expected frontend files were not present at the documented paths during discovery; inspect the actual repository structure before implementation.
instructions_to_main_agent.quality_bar: Prioritize usable flows and responsive states over decorative effects. Verify every interactive element has data-testid and both themes remain legible.
